text:
ravi: Heads up — during the 09:20 batch window we saw P99 east-west latency between GPU nodes spike from ~3ms to 600ms, causing timeouts on a batch job. Anyone else seeing this?

maria: Yep, saw it on prod-gpu-pool-3. Influx shows TCP retransmits and packet loss rising at same time. Service A started failing 09:19-09:23.

cluster-bot: ALERT gpu-network: east-west-latency-high on prod-gpu-pool-3 (p99=612ms) — triggered at 2025-10-17T09:19:23Z

jon: Can you paste `ss -s` and `ifconfig` from one of affected nodes? Also are we on RDMA-enabled NICs or plain TCP?

maria: Quick dumps below from gpu-node-23 (09:21):
```
# ss -s
TCP: inuse 456 orphan 0 tw 87 alloc 12345 mem 0
Rcvbuf: 0, Tbsize: 0
segments retransmitted: 132
# ethtool -S eth0 | head
rx_errors: 0
tx_errors: 0
rx_no_buffer: 154
rx_missed: 4
```

sophie: rx_no_buffer is suspicious — could be MTU mismatch or driver offload issues. Did we recently push jumbo frames change?

ravi: We rolled back jumbo frames last week. MTU is 1500 on most hosts, but some nodes in pool-3 were still on 9000 during the rollout.

jon: MTU mismatch would explain large packet fragmentation causing slow path, especially with kernel checksum offload. Also check `dmesg` for mlx5 errors.

maria: dmesg excerpt:
```
[  123.456789] mlx5_core 0000:03:00.0: CQE major error, syndrome 0x3
[  123.456800] mlx5_core 0000:03:00.0: port flapping, error
```

aiops: Observed RDMA flapping on 3 nodes, fallback to TCP observed — latency jumps align with flaps.

sophie: If RDMA falls back to TCP mid-batch, KV cache transfers increase and batching bursts will hit CPU and NIC queueing. Also ECMP rebalancing can cause out-of-order packets which wreck TCP performance.

ravi: Impact: ~12% throughput drop for high-batch clients, tail latency causing 503s. Cost risk — retries blow up token spend.

jon: Short-term mitigation: pin pods to single host (nodeAffinity) for heavy batching workloads, reduce max_batch_size and increase batching timeout to smooth peaks. Also can deploy kernel param tweak: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_retries2=8` and increase `net.core.netdev_max_backlog`.

maria: Can we try disabling TSO/GRO on affected NICs as test? `ethtool -K eth0 tso off gso off gro off`

sophie: Also check switch counters — vendor (Arista) shows large RX drop bursts on leaf-12 around same time. Might be buffer starvation on the leaf.

ravi: Action items: 1) infra to check MTU consistency and roll forward jumbo frames patch to all nodes in pool-3; 2) network to check Arista leaf buffers and QoS config; 3) app to apply nodeAffinity and smaller batch size for canary 10% traffic; 4) ops to collect pcap for next spike window.

jon: I'll open a CR with details and schedule pcap capture for 09:20 tomorrow.

maria: For recording: `pcapng` will be uploaded to s3://redwood-debug/gpu-net/1758001234.pcapng

sophie: Also flagging to Product — this affects SLA for Dedicated customers in us-west-2. @helen FYI :warning:

ravi: Thanks all. Marking as in-progress — we'll update thread after next window. :thumbsup:
